description: This file implements metrics server management, including starting, stopping, and handling plugin metrics routes, within the Mattermost platform. It defines the platformMetrics struct, methods for server control, and HTTP handlers for profiling and plugin metrics.

classes.name: platformMetrics
classes.description: Struct managing metrics server, router, and related configurations within the platform.

methods.name: resetMetrics
methods.description: Resets or initializes the metrics server based on configuration.

methods.name: stopMetricsServer
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the metrics server.

methods.name: startMetricsServer
methods.description: Starts the metrics HTTP server and listens for incoming requests.

methods.name: initMetricsRouter
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP router with profiling, metrics, and plugin routes.

methods.name: servePluginMetricsRequest
methods.description: Handles plugin-specific metrics requests, serving plugin metrics or errors.
